parameters.prompt:
Write a high-quality, engaging, and SEO-optimized blog post for our tattoo directory & booking platform, Ink Connect.

Choose an interesting and relevant topic, such as:
1. Detailed tattoo aftercare instructions and recovery stages.
2. How to choose a tattoo style (e.g., Traditional, Realism, Neo-Traditional, Fine Line).
3. Budgeting for a tattoo and understanding artist pricing.
4. How to prepare for your first tattoo session (pain management, eating, clothing).
5. Deciding on placement based on design size and complexity.

Respond ONLY with a valid JSON object matching this schema. Do not wrap the JSON in markdown code blocks or add any other text:
{
  "title": "A catchy, click-worthy SEO title",
  "slug": "a-url-safe-lowercase-slug-matching-the-title-with-hyphens",
  "summary": "A short 1-2 sentence excerpt of the article for listings",
  "content": "The full blog post content. Structure it with subheaders using ## and ###. Use simple paragraphs separated by double newlines for formatting. Make sure the content is thorough, informative, and at least 600 words."
}
